messages:
mira: FYI reservation queue for A100-pool in us-west-1 spiked — available reserved slots down to ~5%. Lead time for new commitments jumped to 6-8 weeks. We have three pending reserved requests that need decisions.

sam: Which three? can we prioritize customer-impacting ones? :thinking_face:

mira: Pending: 1) analytics-prod (Q2 launch) 2) internal-eval (non-urgent) 3) enterprise-42 (SLA req). I'll paste current queue snapshot:
```
queue_len: 42
reserved_avail: 5
expected_provision_slot: 2026-05-01 -> +6w
hot_requests: analytics-prod, enterprise-42
```

alex: Could we re-route new dedicated commits to us-east-2? cheaper + faster availability last check. Any networking/latency issues for analytics-prod?

jordan: Give me the cost delta (commit VS spot) and egress/replication overhead for cross-region. We might absorb if it's short-term.

mira: Quick numbers:
`us-west-1 reserved unit cost: $2.40/hr`
`us-east-2 reserved unit cost: $2.15/hr`
`replication bandwidth est: 6TB/mo -> $~120/mo`
If we move analytics-prod, add ~10ms p50 for that service.

finance-ops: @jordan rough calc: if we take 10 units reserved in us-east-2 vs waiting, monthly saving ≈ $1560 but migration ops cost ~1.5 engineer-days.

sam: For enterprise-42 (SLA), can we carve from reserved in eu-west-1 pool? I know they requested eu region specifically.

mira: eu-west-1 is also tight. Option: temporary burst to hosted pooled capacity (higher per-token cost) + fast ticket to sales for customer approval. Not ideal but keeps SLA.

infra-bot: Reservation ticket CREATED: #58031 (mira) — workflow: triage -> region-shift proposal -> finance approval

alex: Proposal: 1) Move analytics-prod to us-east-2 committed capacity, 2) Put enterprise-42 on hosted burst until reserved available, 3) deprioritize internal-eval.

jordan: +1 on cost grounds but need sign-off form from sales/customer. I'll prepare quick cost sheet.

sam: I'll update the queue priority and put a note on the customer-facing incident. Anyone want to take the migration runbook?

mira: I'll take runbook and start region-reserve ticket. @alex can you coordinate db replication steps?

alex: On it. Will post checklist + a short rollback plan here.

finance-ops: Ping if you want me to pre-approve the short-term spend. We can fast-track up to $10k for migration ops.

mira: ok. I'll update ticket #58031 with decisions and ETA. Thanks all :rocket:
